rows.academy_of_prisons_correctional_administ: E/Filling up the post of Director/2026
Serving officers: parent scale of pay plus Special Compensatory Allowance of 15% of basic pay; retired officers: pay fixed as per the order of the respective State Government

Inspector General / Additional Inspector General of Prisons, or Deputy Inspector General of Prisons with 5 years of experience, by deputation (serving) or re-employment (retired); retired IG / Addl. IG from non-participating States also considered
Director, Academy of Prisons & Correctional Administration, Vellore - 632 002, Tamil Nadu, India

content_sections.heading: APCA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. E/Filling up the post of Director/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download APCA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: By deputation from the cadre of Inspector General of Prisons / Additional Inspector General of Prisons, or from the cadre of Deputy Inspector General of Prisons with 5 years of experience, from the participating States; By re-employment of retired Inspector General of Prisons / Additional Inspector General of Prisons from the participating States; In the event of non-availability of the above officers, by re-employment of retired Deputy Inspector General of Prisons with 5 years of experience; By re-employment of officers of the rank of Inspector General of Prison / Additional Inspector General of Prisons from the non-participating States Experience: 5 years of experience for Deputy Inspector General of Prisons Other conditions: Both serving and retired prison officers are eligible.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for APCA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications without Service Register will not be considered. Applications received after 15.11.2026 will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Retired and re-employed officers: pay and allowances fixed as per the terms and conditions in the order issued by the respective State Government concerned. Deputation for a period of 2 years initially. Board may extend the deputation from time to time depending on suitability. Board has the power to reduce the deputation period and repatriate the officer if found unsuitable.

rows.event: Board of Management 113th meeting (resolution to fill the post)
Last date for receipt of applications by Director, APCA

content_sections.heading: How Will APCA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications after the cut-off date Eligible applicants placed before the Board of Management of APCA Personal appearance if necessary, or selection by the Board from among the applicants All applications scrutinised after the cut-off date; eligible applicants separated and placed before the Board of Management of APCA. Board may call for the personal appearance of the candidate if necessary, or may select one among the applicants. Decisions of the Board of Management are final; no further correspondence entertained.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio Data with educational qualifications, entry level into service, positions held, retired as, years served as Superintendent, DIG and IG of Prisons Bio Data details of awards and rewards, research and publications, and contributions to the State Prisons Department Service Register

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APCA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Prepare the application with Bio Data and Service Register. Hand over the application in the office of the Director General of Prisons of the respective State. The Head of the Department forwards it with the Service Register to the Director, APCA. Applications must reach Director, APCA by 15.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Heads of Prison Departments of all States and UTs are requested to circulate the letter, receive applications and forward them with Service Registers. Contact: Office +91 (0) 416 2267907, Mobile +91 (0) 9447 694767, Email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in APCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Director.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for APCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Director, Academy of Prisons & Correctional Administration, Vellore - 632 002, Tamil Nadu, India, by by hand to the office of the director general of prisons of the respective state, forwarded through the head of the department, to reach by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Serving officers: parent scale of pay plus Special Compensatory Allowance of 15% of basic pay; retired officers: pay fixed as per the order of the respective State Government.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Inspector General / Additional Inspector General of Prisons, or Deputy Inspector General of Prisons with 5 years of experience, by deputation (serving) or re-employment (retired); retired IG / Addl. IG from non-participating States also considered.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Both serving and retired prison officers are eligible.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications without Service Register will not be considered. Applications received after 15.11.2026 will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications after the cut-off date. Eligible applicants placed before the Board of Management of APCA. Personal appearance if necessary, or selection by the Board from among the applicants. All applications scrutinised after the cut-off date; eligible applicants separated and placed before the Board of Management of APCA.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation for a period of 2 years initially. Board may extend the deputation from time to time depending on suitability. Board has the power to reduce the deputation period and repatriate the officer if found unsuitable.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Vellore, Tamil Nadu.
